name: switchboard
description: Picks the cheapest Claude model and effort level that fits the work (Haiku for lookups, Sonnet for routine edits, Opus for architecture, security and hard bugs) and says how to run a prompt in a subagent at that setting without changing the session's own. Also says when a long session should stay, use a subagent or start fresh, and writes a carry-over brief so a new session can pick up its artifacts. Add switchboard-hook for automatic per-prompt routing.
